correctness.rationale: For any odd n>=3, P_x,P_y,P_z are pairwise anticommuting Hermitian involutions, so B_w²=||w||²_2 I and its operator norm is ||w||_2. On a product state the Bloch-coordinate Cauchy–Schwarz bound gives expectation <=||w||_infty and product Pauli eigenstates achieve equality. For the actual product of rho marginals, trace duality bounds the positive witness gap by ||B_w||*||rho−rho_1⊗...⊗rho_n||_1. Quantum Pinsker with natural logs yields 1/2 times square; maximizing over w using the l1-ball support function ||w||_infty gives precisely 1/2 dist2(c,B1)^2. Local depolarizing c(t)=exp(-nt)c(0) makes the certificate positive iff its l1 sum >1, yielding the stated lifetime. The physical anticommuting-state witness rho_a is positive for a<=1/sqrt2, and gives the strict 3/2 factor versus fixed equal weights.

value.rationale: This is an exact strongest certificate within an explicitly motivated experimentally accessible observable family, not a claim that the physical total correlation is determined by three numbers. It can strictly improve the anchor lower bound for positive physical states, supplies a closed soft-threshold formula and identifies the precise finite-noise horizon when this certificate ceases to detect correlation. The odd/even anticommutation boundary is mathematically essential.

scientific_limitations: Odd n>=3, three full Pauli strings, natural-log quantum Pinsker, equal-rate local depolarizing for lifetime; no even-n envelope or total-correlation equality.
